prompts.hero:
Use case: stylized-concept. FINAL PRODUCTION CHARACTER SPRITE ATLAS on TRUE TRANSPARENT background. One perfectly regular 4 columns by 4 rows grid, SIXTEEN equal cells, no drawn grid lines. Same charming ORIGINAL piglet in every cell: peach-pink pig, rounded floppy ears, tiny forelock, expressive dark eyes, red scarf, dark teal adventure shorts with small brass belt buckle, cocoa brown hooves. Upright biped on two hind legs, short appealing limbs, large round head, sturdy little body. All poses same character scale, head proportions, costume, fixed center body x and feet baseline, generous transparent padding, nothing crossing cell boundaries.
Read left to right then next row:
ROW 1: running cycle frames 1-4: right-foot contact, down recoil, legs passing, airborne up stride.
ROW 2: running cycle frames 5-8: left-foot contact, down recoil, legs passing, airborne up stride. Arms counter-swing, ears and red scarf follow through. Exaggerated clear silhouette, lively determined smile.
ROW 3: calm standing idle, blink standing idle, takeoff with knees tucked and ears up, falling with legs extended preparing to land.
ROW 4: punch wind-up fist near cheek, active big forward hoof punch arm fully extended to RIGHT (no motion smear), punch follow-through leaning forward, hanging overhead from two hands with legs tucked (no rope).
Full body in all cells. Match hero identity/style in reference, but now a full running biped. Absolutely no text, numbers, scenery, shadows below feet, labels or ground. High consistency across sixteen frames.
